prompt:
Compute the value of the following expression. Reply with a single integer on the last line in the form 'Answer: <integer>'.

((5 + 7) * 7)

The following logical clauses must all be true, where a variable may be true or false and 'not X' means X is false. Exactly one assignment of the variables satisfies every clause.

  (not Q)
  (not P or not Q)
  (not P)
  (not Q or not P)

Give the value of P, Q in that order, each as true or false, separated by commas, on the last line in the form 'Answer: <value>, <value>, ...'.

A set of ordering constraints is given. Exactly one ordering of the items satisfies all constraints. List the items in that order, separated by commas, on the last line in the form 'Answer: item1, item2, ...'.

Items: cedar, dune, amber
Constraints:
  cedar must come before amber
  amber must come before dune

The following undirected graph has weighted edges. The cost of a path is the sum of its edge weights. What is the minimum cost from A to D?

  A -- B : weight 2
  A -- C : weight 6
  B -- C : weight 9
  C -- D : weight 3

Reply with a single integer on the last line in the form 'Answer: <integer>'.

The following deterministic state machine starts in state s0. Process the input string 1110 one symbol at a time, moving according to the transition table. What is the final state?

  s0 -- 0 --> s0
  s0 -- 1 --> s1
  s1 -- 0 --> s0
  s1 -- 1 --> s1
  s2 -- 0 --> s1
  s2 -- 1 --> s1

Reply with the state name (for example 'Answer: <state name>') on the last line.
